preregistered_distinction: Whether an encoder authored strictly from format.md by an uncontaminated implementer reproduces reference.py's output on the probe set (format.md is silent on entry ordering, on escaping the backslash itself, and on escaping inside keys; the reference sorts keys and escapes backslashes everywhere).
rationale: Evidence requirement E-B demands a clean-room implementation comparison; the decision-maker is contaminated by reference.py the moment it observes the package, so the required evidence can only be generated by a fresh isolated descendant.
